intro: All food is freshly cooked and prepared in The Alma’s continued Scores on the Doors 5-star rated kitchen. Lunch gets busy, so bookings are recommended while walk-ins remain welcome.
highlights: Stuffed crust stone-baked pizzas available through the week
Selected Sunday carvery dates including key seasonal days
Event buffet and BBQ menu options for suitable private bookings

menus.title: Lunch Menu
menus.text: Freshly cooked lunchtime pub food, served Monday to Friday from 12pm to 2:30pm.

menus.title: Stuffed Crust Pizzas
menus.text: 9” and 10” stone-baked stuffed crust pizzas, available most days until the evening kitchen cut-off.

menus.title: Manze’s Pie & Mash
menus.text: A regular Alma favourite served on selected dates. Check the events page for the next sitting.

menus.title: Sunday Carvery Dates
menus.text: Selected carvery events across the year, including Mother’s Day, Easter Sunday, Father’s Day, November and Christmas Day.

menus.title: Function Food
menus.text: Buffet and BBQ options for wakes, meetings, celebrations and private gatherings.
